documentation.content: Program-synthesis Functions logged N>=2 ERRORs in 5 min (`synthesis_error_count`: startProgramSynthesis, getProgramSynthesisStatus, processProgramSynthesisJob). Threshold is 2, not 1, because expected client errors (monthly quota, invalid args) also log at ERROR. If the errors are all quota/invalid-argument rejections, treat as noise and check abuse instead of paging. Otherwise triage the dispatcher/solver path per `docs/cloud-program-synthesis-deploy.md` section 7. Context: STR-24.
